title: The magnitude of the pharmacodynamic index for NOSO-502: pathogen clearance, emergence of resistance and human dose predictions
locator: Methods / Human dose prediction, paragraphs 3-6; Results / Human dose prediction
quote: the normalized PK profile of each species
summary: CL and Vss methods feed normalized animal IV profiles; Wajima rescaling supplies curve shape. Humanized profiles were fitted jointly by naive pooling. Human unbound fraction is an input to binding-dependent methods.
validation: Prediction and intermethod agreement are not observed human validation. Naive pooling does not estimate human interindividual variability.
data_availability: Supplementary material listed; full raw profiles and executable code not verified.
